title: Giant found dead at a table with oysters in a sealed tower

tellings.quote: there was a giant seated at a table and he was dead.

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, relays a story he was told from Santa Anastasia, on the Italian island of Sardinia, around 1978 to 1981. According to Alberino, when a sealed stone tower was opened, a giant was found inside, seated dead at a table with oysters. If true, it would mean giants once lived there and were later hidden away.
